name: opt-in-measured-touch-replaces-direct-placeholder
description: A stored recordDirectTouch placeholder holds the first-touch slot only until the first measured touch, which replaces it as first touch.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (opt-in, #56): the only exception to first-touch write-once; it applies only to stored 'Direct' / 'Unknown (before capture)' placeholders without click IDs. Semver: additive opt-in parse option (minor); defaults, CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
